lesson_title: We Tipped Out Our Rubbish Bin. Here Is What We Found.
hook_text: We tipped our family's rubbish bin onto the floor. Half of it should never have been there.
clip_script: Gloves on, bin tipped out. Stale bread and old rice: that is money thrown away. Fix: plan meals, compost the peels. That is reduce. Glass jars and tubs: wash them, store beans and sugar. Reuse. Cans, cardboard, plastic bottles: separate bag, and on Thursday a waste picker sells them at the buy-back centre. Recycle, and someone earns an income. Two weeks later, the bin is half as full and the food bill is smaller. Reduce first, then reuse, then recycle. Same goods, more needs met, less waste.
visual_style: A whiteboard bin spilling items into three labelled boxes, reduce, reuse and recycle, with a shrinking bin and a growing coin stack.
mood: Hands-on and slightly gross in a fun way, ending proud.
pacing: Fast sorting of bin items, then a satisfying before-and-after.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and run a one-week bin check at home.
